facts.text: Victor, Hugo and Laverne say come up for supper. Bring bread for the pigeons. The bells are not too loud tonight.
facts.why: Quasimodo never says this. It is not in the film's dialogue. His real line about the festival is 'If I picked a day to fly, oh, this would be it!' Hugo's food line, 'Pour the wine and cut the cheese', would also work if the portrait badge were changed.
facts.fix: If I picked a day to fly, oh, this would be it!

fix_note.text: If I picked a day to fly, oh, this would be it!

vibe.verdict: A tidy bell tower menu with the gargoyles and Djali, but it avoids the festival chaos and the poster sits in a dark letterbox that looks flat.
